name: Vault Audit Ai
description: Plugin settings

name: Свой API
description: Any OpenAI-compatible

name: API key
description: If your provider requires it

name: Model
description: Provider's model ID

name: Model — Свой API
description: Provider's model ID

name: Base URL
description: URL of your OpenAI-compatible API

name: Temperature
description: Response creativity: 0.0 = precise, 1.0 = creative

name: Enable semantic features
description: Semantic features are opt-in. The first Vault index is started manually.

name: Automatic semantic index synchronization
description: After the first index exists, Markdown note changes are synchronized automatically. Changed chunks may be sent to the selected remote embedding provider; Ollama can generate embeddings locally. The vector index remains local and Markdown files are not modified. An incompatible embedding space requires an explicit rebuild.

name: Embedding provider
description: Works independently from the language model above.

name: Embedding model
description: Embedding model name as shown in Ollama.

name: Embeddings base URL
description: Base HTTP(S) URL without query or fragment. The endpoint is appended automatically.

name: Embeddings API key
description: Required for OpenAI; a custom API may not require it.

name: Semantic index controls
description: The initial update, Clear, and Rebuild are explicit operations; ordinary Markdown changes are then synchronized automatically.

name: Включить Companion
description: Опционально передаёт read-only mirror текущего semantic index настроенному Companion endpoint. Первый sync запускается явно.

name: Companion endpoint
description: Локально: http://127.0.0.1:27124. Remote endpoint должен использовать HTTPS.

name: Companion token
description: Отдельный Bearer token Companion. Хранится локально в данных плагина и никогда не отправляется AI-провайдерам.

name: Companion
description: Remote Companion получает vault-relative пути, Markdown, chunk text, metadata и embeddings. Используйте только HTTPS и доверенный сервер.

name: Files per request
description: Recommended 3-7. More = faster, but risks exceeding the context

name: Parallel requests
description: Free tier: 1-2. Paid: up to 5-6

name: Delay between requests (ms)
description: Increase on 429 Rate Limit errors

name: Folder for new notes
description: Empty = vault root

name: Folder for MOC notes
description: Where MOCs generated from audit clusters are stored

name: Where to put atomic notes
description: Next to the original keeps the folder's thematic context

name: Folder for atomic notes
description: Used only in the “shared folder” mode

name: Filename template
description: Переменные: {{date}}, {{time}}, {{topic}}

name: Interface language
description: Auto — follow Obsidian. Command names update after the plugin reloads.

name: Context menu
description: AI Hub item in the right-click menu (requires reload)
